units.text: I helped to keep data flow from field devices running. When data was missing I looked into it.
I compared 3 months of fault alerts with maintenance work orders, to see which was real. I set own threshold for each sensor model. Weekly false alerts fell from 140 to 45.
I implemented over-the-air firmware updates with C for FreeRTOS sensor nodes. I used A/B partitions so failed update rolls back automatic. I rolled it out to 300 field sensors in 5 months.
